name: Breakout Retest
thesis: Range breakouts with volume confirmation trap the other side; the retest that holds converts trapped traders into fuel, paying continuation in the breakout direction.
invalidation: Demote after profit factor below 0.9 over 20 trades or drawdown beyond 8%.

provenance.note: Port of eval_breakout_retest. Two deliberate differences. (1) The range level must EXCLUDE the breakout bar: donchian_hi(48) already contains bar i-1, so `prev(close,1) > donchian_hi(48)` is unsatisfiable by construction and scored zero signals on 8000 real bars. prev(donchian_hi(48), 2) ends the window at i-3, matching the legacy df.iloc[-n-5:-2]. (2) The legacy volume test only scales confidence (0.66 vs 0.50) and never gates the signal; here it is a hard filter, so this fires ~28% less often.

entry_long: prev(close, 1) > prev(donchian_hi(48), 2) and (abs(low - prev(donchian_hi(48), 2)) <= 0.5 * atr(14) or close >= prev(donchian_hi(48), 2))
entry_short: prev(close, 1) < prev(donchian_lo(48), 2) and (abs(high - prev(donchian_lo(48), 2)) <= 0.5 * atr(14) or close <= prev(donchian_lo(48), 2))
